mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_search_document(content_type, content_id, document_key, title, summary, searchable_text, route_path, published_at, source_updated_at, status) VALUES (#{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{documentKey}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{searchableText}, #{routePath}, #{publishedAt}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, 'ACTIVE') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), summary = VALUES(summary), searchable_text = VALUES(searchable_text), route_path = VALUES(route_path), published_at = VALUES(published_at), source_updated_at = VALUES(source_updated_at), status = 'ACTIVE', indexed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_search_document SET status = 'REMOVED' WHERE document_key = #{documentKey}
UPDATE sr_search_document SET status = 'REMOVED' WHERE content_type = #{contentType} AND content_id = #{contentId}
UPDATE sr_search_document SET status = 'REMOVED' WHERE content_type = 'CHAPTER' AND LEFT(route_path, CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix})) = #{prefix}
mapper.select: SELECT document_key FROM sr_search_document WHERE content_type = #{contentType} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_search_document WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_search_document WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( MATCH(title, summary, searchable_text) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{query}, title) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{query}, COALESCE(summary, '')) > 0)

SELECT content_type AS contentType, CAST(content_id AS CHAR) AS contentId, title, summary, route_path AS routePath, published_at AS publishedAt, MATCH(title, summary, searchable_text) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) + CASE WHEN LOCATE(#{query}, title) > 0 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN LOCATE(#{query}, COALESCE(summary, '')) > 0 THEN 0.5 ELSE 0 END AS score FROM sr_search_document WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( MATCH(title, summary, searchable_text) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{query}, title) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{query}, COALESCE(summary, '')) > 0)
ORDER BY score DESC, published_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT title AS text, content_type AS contentType, route_path AS routePath FROM sr_search_document WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND (LOCATE(#{query}, title) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{query}, COALESCE(summary, '')) > 0) ORDER BY CASE WHEN LEFT(title, CHAR_LENGTH(#{query})) = #{query} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, published_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
